Mr. N.M. Joseph Forests Note: Only the main party leaders Mr. Nayanar (CPI-M), Sreenivasan (CPI), Baby John (RSP) and Mr. Chandrasekharan (Janata) were sworn in on March 26. The other Ministers were inducted into the 19-member Cabinet on April 2, 1987. However, Mr. Veerendra Kumar had to resign on April 7 and Mr. N. M. Joseph was made the Minister in his place on April 14

Mr. Ramakrishnan was not a member of LegislativeAssembly at the time of joining the Ministry. He was elected from Kottayam constituency on June 3, 1987. * The resignation of the Ministry was accepted by the Governor on June 17, 1991 and requested to continue till alternative arrangements are made.
